chains.title: Ref G preserves an HNF4A half-site in a hepatocyte enhancer driving PLAG1/CHCHD7; alt T weakens it and lowers expression
chains.element: Putative liver enhancer at chr8:57.57Mb within the PLAG1/CHCHD7/MOS/RPS20 interval

links.claim: The G allele completes a DR1-like nuclear-receptor motif (AGGTCA-like half-site) bound by HNF4A; the T allele disrupts the core and reduces predicted affinity. HNF4A is chosen within the HNF4/NR2F specificity group because HNF4A is the dominant family member expressed in hepatocytes.
The variant lies in a non-coding, likely enhancer-like region active in liver; loss of the HNF4A site reduces enhancer output.
The enhancer contacts the PLAG1/CHCHD7 promoter region, so the alt allele lowers PLAG1 expression in liver.
Effect is hepatocyte-restricted because HNF4A occupancy at this element requires liver-specific factor availability.
Altered PLAG1-dependent transcriptional program changes hepatic lipoprotein handling, shifting plasma LDL cholesterol.

predictions: HNF4A ChIP-seq in HepG2/Hep3B shows a peak overlapping the variant with allelic imbalance favouring G
HNF4A knockdown in Hep3B reduces reporter activity of the G allele specifically
eQTL for PLAG1 or CHCHD7 in liver with G associated with higher expression
falsified_if: No HNF4A ChIP signal or open chromatin at the site in liver cells
Luciferase reporter shows no allelic difference, or T > G
HNF4A knockdown leaves allelic reporter difference intact

chains.title: Alt T creates a CEBPB site that increases repressive/activating occupancy at a liver element, altering local gene expression

links.claim: The T allele generates a TTGC-containing bZIP half-site matching the C/EBP specificity group; CEBPB is chosen over CEBPA/CEBPD because it is robustly expressed in Hep3B and in adult liver and has the broadest ChIP-seq footprint there.
Gained C/EBP occupancy changes the regulatory output of this element in liver.
Nearest promoter affected is CHCHD7/PLAG1 bidirectional region; expression shifts with genotype.
CEBPB is highly active in hepatocytes, confining the effect to liver.
Changed hepatic expression alters LDL receptor pathway flux and plasma LDL cholesterol.

predictions: EMSA with Hep3B nuclear extract shows a new CEBP-family complex on the T probe, supershifted by anti-CEBPB
CEBPB ChIP-qPCR enrichment at the locus is genotype-dependent
falsified_if: No gained complex on the T probe
CEBPB knockdown does not change allelic reporter difference

chains.title: A FOXA pioneer site is altered, changing chromatin accessibility of the element in liver
chains.target_gene: PENK/MOS-proximal regulatory domain (nearest expressed liver gene in the TAD)

links.claim: The G allele supports a forkhead core (TGTTT-like); the T allele degrades it. FOXA2 is selected from the FOXA specificity group because FOXA1/FOXA2/FOXA3 share the motif but FOXA2 is the most highly expressed forkhead pioneer factor in hepatocyte lines.
FOXA2 acts as a pioneer; weaker binding reduces nucleosome displacement and accessibility of the element.
Reduced accessibility lowers transcription of the nearest liver-expressed gene in the same contact domain.
Downstream change in hepatic lipid gene expression shifts LDL cholesterol.

predictions: ATAC-seq in heterozygous liver shows allelic imbalance in accessibility favouring G
Effect persists after HNF4A or CEBPB knockdown
falsified_if: FOXA2 ChIP shows no binding at the element
